@@U04092@@
It’s there I see the enemy defeated
in a savage encounter.

@@U04094@@
And there they come,
treacherous, false kinsmen,
who called me uncle, cousin, brother,
taking one liberty after another,
robbing my throne of power and authority,
laying waste the empire with internal feuding,
and now, as rebels, they join to march against me.
Yes, and then the masses,
uncertain which way to turn,
follow wherever the current carries them.

@@U04096@@
I’ve sent out as spies two men I trust.
Here comes the first.
I hope his news is good.

@@U04098@@
Sire, we managed to get through and
work our way among them as ordered,
but the news, I’m afraid, isn’t good.
Many of the princes swear loyalty to the crown,
but claim that rebellions in their own domains
force them to take no action.

@@U04100@@
Self-interest always wins out—
over gratitude, affection, duty, honor.
Do you never consider that when your neighbor's
house is burning yours may be the next?

@@U04102@@
Here’s the second.
How slowly he descends the hill,
every limb of him aching.
translation:
@@U04092@@
在那里我看到敌人被击败
在一次野蛮的遭遇中。

@@U04094@@
他们来了，
奸诈的、假亲戚的，
谁叫我叔叔、表弟、兄弟，
一次又一次的自由，
夺走了我的权力和权威的宝座，
内讧毁掉了帝国，
现在，他们作为反叛者联合起来反对我。
是的，然后大众，
不确定该转向哪个方向，
随潮流而行。

@@U04096@@
我派出了两个我信任的人作为间谍。
第一个来了。
我希望他的消息是好消息。

@@U04098@@
陛下，我们成功渡过了难关
我们按照命令在他们中间工作，
但恐怕这个消息并不好。
许多王子发誓效忠王室，
但声称在自己的领域内发生叛乱
迫使他们不采取任何行动。

@@U04100@@
自身利益总是胜出——
超越感恩、感情、责任、荣誉。
当你的邻居
房子着火了，下一个可能就是你的吗？

@@U04102@@
这是第二个。
他多么缓慢地走下山，
他的每一个肢体都在疼痛。
